intro: Enter your points for the month. The calculation runs in your browser: nothing is stored or sent.
invalid: Enter a number of points equal to or greater than 0.

contracts.partitaIva: Porta a Porta incl. partita IVA

own.customerTurnoverHelp: Points of the orders paid this month by your customers, including your own orders.
own.customerTurnoverHelpUsa: Points of the orders paid this month by your customers, excluding your own purchases.
own.personalTurnoverHelp: Points of your own purchases paid this month.

result.title: Estimated commission
result.noLevel: With these points you do not reach Target Level 1 (110 points of your own CT). There would be no commission this month.
result.limit: Limit for the strongest team ({{team}}: TT {{volume}}, limit {{limit}})

notes.voucher: Remember: as it does not exceed {{threshold}}, it will be paid as a discount voucher.
notes.taxSettlement: In this market RINGANA also sends a settlement document for tax reasons: the final amount may differ.
notes.provisionalLimit: The limit for the strongest team is applied provisionally while we confirm with RINGANA how it is calculated.
notes.exceptions: If your fair score is below 100 % or the «RINGANA only» rule applies to you, your actual commission will be lower.
notes.bonuses: Bonuses are not included (Fast Track, Growth Bonus, Beyond Target 10).
notes.breakdownMissing: The limit for the strongest team is not applied yet: complete that team’s breakdown for a more accurate result.
notes.limitNotApplied: Your strongest team ({{team}}, TT {{volume}}) exceeds the limit of Target Level {{level}} ({{limit}}). We are still confirming how RINGANA applies it, so it is not deducted for now: your actual commission could be lower.

generations.help: Copy them from the Online Office: Statistics → Team structure, «Points» column.
generations.deepHelp: They only count for TT: they earn no commission.

warnings.teamVolumesMissing: The TT of your direct partners is missing: without it your strongest teams cannot be subtracted and the Target Level may come out higher than the real one.
warnings.teamVolumesExceedDownline: The TT of your direct partners adds up to more than all generations together. Please check the data.
warnings.breakdownDoesNotMatchTeam: The breakdown of the strongest team does not add up to its TT. Please check the data.
warnings.breakdownExceedsGeneration: A generation of the breakdown is larger than that generation’s total. Please check the data.
warnings.teamMinusMissing: Your TT-1, TT-2 or TT-3 is missing: without them your Target Level may come out lower than the real one. Copy them from the Online Office.
warnings.teamMinusInconsistent: Your TT-1, TT-2 and TT-3 do not add up (each must be between your CT and the previous one, not above your TT). Please check the data.

next.newPartners: Partners who join this month do not count until next month; then their points of both months count.

chart.title: Your estimated commission by CT
chart.subtitle: With your teams’ forecast. The jumps are Target Level changes.

legs.aliasHelp: Her first name, to recognise her. Only kept in this browser tab.

data.note: Your data is kept only in this browser tab and deleted when you close it.

emptyState.text: You are starting from zero, useful for planning ahead. To start from your real data, enter it in «My current commission».

reverse.intro: Enter how much you would like to earn, how much CT you are willing to make and how much you think your team will make. We tell you whether you get there and, if not, your alternatives. Changes here do not affect the other tabs.
reverse.summary: If you add {{own}} points and your team {{team}}, you would reach Target Level {{level}} with an estimated commission of {{amount}}.

strategies.levelling: Levelled split: the weakest teams first, which raises your TT-1 the most.
strategies.proportional: Split in proportion to each team’s TT.
strategies.equal: The same number of points for each team.

infeasible.noLegs: Add your teams above (or enter an average) to see alternatives with your team.
infeasible.ownBelowLevel1: Below Target Level 1 (110 points of your own CT) your team earns you no commission: you first need 110 points.
infeasible.unreachable: It cannot be reached with this data.

notes.assumption: We assume each team’s points are made by the direct partner herself (1st generation): they are paid at that generation’s rate and raise her team’s TT.
notes.proposal: «Proposal» is the best combination we found among several ways of splitting; it is not necessarily the only one or the absolute minimum.
notes.estimate: These are estimates and conditions, not income promises: the official settlement is RINGANA’s.

reverse.willingOwn: CT you are willing to make
reverse.willingOwnHelp: If you come from «Plan my Target Level», it is your expected CT.
reverse.expected: What you think she will make (TT)
reverse.enough: Your plan gets you there! Target Level {{level}}, estimated commission {{amount}}.
reverse.notEnough: Your plan is not enough: you would reach {{amount}} (Target Level {{level}}), {{missing}} short.
reverse.notEnoughNoLevel: With your plan you do not reach Target Level 1 (110 points of your own CT): {{missing}} short.
reverse.partners: With teams making {{average}} points on average, you would need {{count}} more active teams: Target Level {{level}}, estimated commission {{amount}}.
reverse.partnersNone: With that average you would not get there even with {{max}} more teams.
reverse.partnersNoAverage: Enter what you think your teams will make to work out how many more partners you would need.
reverse.partnersNote: A new partner counts from the month after she joins.
reverse.partnersProspecting: Statistically, about {{cn}} business conversations (BC) to find them, and they have to join the month before your goal.
reverse.loadFromPlan: Load the legs from «Plan my Target Level» (replaces the ones here):

teamMinus.help: Copy them from the Online Office: in the list of partners, your own row (columns TT-1, TT-2 and TT-3). We use them to work out your Target Level.

plan.intro: Choose the Target Level you want to reach and enter how much you and each team expect to make this month. You will see straight away whether you get there and what is missing.
plan.daysLeft: {{days}} days left until the month closes (today included).
plan.volumes: With your forecast: TT {{tt}} · TT-1 {{tt1}} · TT-2 {{tt2}} · TT-3 {{tt3}}
plan.targetMet: With this forecast you reach Target Level {{level}}!
plan.ownNeeded: For Target Level {{level}}, with what you expect from your teams, you would need {{own}} CT points ({{extra}} more).
plan.reached: With your forecast you would reach Target Level {{level}}
plan.reachedNone: With your forecast you would not reach Target Level 1.
plan.commissionWithOwn: If you make those {{own}} CT points: {{amount}}.
plan.approximate: Approximate commission: we do not know in which generation your teams’ points are, so we spread them like your generations in «My current commission» (or all in the 1st generation if there is no data).
plan.remember: Keep my plan on this device until I reach my goal
plan.rememberHelp: Kept only in this browser, with no server, even if you close the tab. Untick it or press «Delete plan» to remove it.
plan.fictitiousHelp: Tick it if this is a partner you still have to find.
plan.prospecting_one: Your plan counts on {{count}} partner who has not joined yet. To count in {{month}} she has to join in {{joinMonth}} at the latest: start having business conversations (BC) now. Statistically, about {{cn}} BC.
plan.prospecting_other: Your plan counts on {{count}} partners who have not joined yet. To count in {{month}} they have to join in {{joinMonth}} at the latest: start having business conversations (BC) now. Statistically, about {{cn}} BC.
plan.prospectingNote: Team statistic: about 10 BC per new partner. A partner who joins in one month counts from the following month, with her points of both months.
plan.pastMonth: This month is over: choose another one to keep planning.
plan.futureMonth: You are planning {{month}}: the daily pace and «Made so far» appear when the month starts.
plan.prospectingLate_one: Your plan counts on {{count}} partner who has not joined yet, but it is too late: to count in {{month}} she should have joined in {{joinMonth}}. Choose a later month or remove her from the plan.
plan.prospectingLate_other: Your plan counts on {{count}} partners who have not joined yet, but it is too late: to count in {{month}} they should have joined in {{joinMonth}}. Choose a later month or remove them from the plan.
